preprocessing: Fixed stratified split; imputation medians and StandardScaler fit only on training data.
iid_method: Random shuffle and balanced array split.
non_iid_method: Per-class Dirichlet client proportions with capacity-aware redistribution to balanced client sample counts.
model: Existing custom logistic regression and FedAvg implementation.
meaning: Smaller alpha generally yields more heterogeneous client label proportions; larger alpha generally yields more similar proportions.
privacy_note: This experiment studies data heterogeneity and does not provide additional privacy protection.
